    About this quiz

    🎧 Part 1: Listening Practice · ✍️ Part 2: Writing Practice

    1. Write your name in the box “Nama kamu”, then press START.
    2. There are 15 questions. In each question you will hear a number in Bahasa Indonesia.
    3. Press the ▶ play button to listen. You can pause and continue. You can play the audio a maximum of 3 times per question (each time it starts from the beginning, or when you press ⟳ replay). After 3 plays, the buttons are locked.
    4. Choose the number you heard from the four options A, B, C, D. You can only choose once.
    5. If your answer is right, it turns green with a ✔ tick. If it is wrong, it turns red with an ✖ cross, and the correct answer is shown in green.
    6. Press ☰ Menu at any time to go back to the home screen (your answers will not be saved).
    7. Press Next to go to the next question. There is no time limit.
    8. At the end, you will see how many answers are correct and wrong. Then you can continue to the ✍️ Writing Practice.
    9. In the Writing Practice, write each number in words (example: 5 → lima). Then press Kumpulkan Jawaban (Submit Answers). Your teacher will check your answers and discuss them before the next class.
    10. At the end, download your answers and send them to your teacher on WhatsApp.

    💡 Tip: In Indonesian, the dot (.) separates thousands. 11.500 = eleven thousand five hundred.
